patches.title: Key V2 sync summaries by selected tip and requested mode
patches.origin: upstream PR by A. Shannon (not ours); production diff only
patches.fixes: a follower that never switches to the heavier chain after a partition heals
patches.witness: fork-convergence A/A on the reference host, 2026-09-25: 23 of 23 valid runs switched, warn_S 0, 1 inconclusive of 24 (prefix race); the release in the same session (a separate measurement from the shipped calibration example, examples/fork-convergence-aa-6.0.6, which is 8 of 16): 6 of 16 switched, warn_S in exactly the 10 that did not

patches.title: MempoolAuditor: rebroadcast a pooled transaction together with its in-pool ancestors
patches.fixes: a transaction announced before its unconfirmed parent is declined by the receiving peer and not requested again for 20 minutes; after a rollback, a chain of wallet payments returns to the pool and reaches the next miner out of order, so most of the chain stays unconfirmed
patches.witness: v2 (bounded iterative walk): unit MempoolAuditorSpec 4/4, change mutated out -> the 2 new tests fail; network reorg-mempool on v6.0.6 + v2: 10 of 10 in both valid runs (2 further runs inconclusive: no rebroadcast round, the payments absent from the sender pool after the rollback, independent of the patch). v1: 10 of 10 in 2 runs.

patches.title: Prevent bestFullBlock/bestHeader divergence on sibling forks
patches.origin: upstream PR by jozanek (not ours); production diff only
patches.fixes: a node's best full block and best header on different forks at the same height (issue #525)
patches.witness: sibling-fork A/A on the reference host, 2026-09-25: 0 of 16 valid runs with confirmed divergence, E_total 0, agreement in all; the release in the same session: 15 of 16 runs with confirmed divergence
responses: 2026-09-25: only_for sibling-fork (temporary): on the combined stack it wedges fork-convergence in 7 of 24 runs (a miner holding a competing header whose body never arrives does not apply its own block); reported on #2313

patches.title: Do not start full block download inside a NiPoPoW headers gap
patches.fixes: a pruned digest node bootstrapped from a NiPoPoW proof latches its full-block floor inside the proof's sparse prefix and never applies a full block (issue #2595)
needed_by: rig nipopow-bootstrap (pruned digest variant, to be added)
patches.witness: unit: PopowProcessorSpecification, four properties (gap, numeric clamp, mid-epoch round-up with no downloads below the floor, continuous-chain regression): on v6.0.7 with the tests alone the first three fail and the regression passes; with the change 6 of 6, history specs 74 of 74 (CI A/B on GitHub-hosted runners to follow); network run of the fixed node not yet done
responses: 2026-09-27: issue #2595 and PR #2596 opened against v6.0.7

patches.title: Do not scan below minimal full block height for block sections near the tip
patches.fixes: a NiPoPoW + UTXO-snapshot node stops downloading blocks when more headers arrive before the snapshot than one scan covers: the near-tip scan starts 100 below the best full block, inside the proof's sparse prefix
patches.witness: unit: UtxoBootstrapToDownloadSpecification 'near the tip, block sections are downloaded after snapshot applied on NiPoPoW-bootstrapped history' fails on v6.0.6, passes with the fix; network: sweep iteration 2 stall + forced-lead A/B (base stalled 2 of 3, with the fix 2 of 2 passed)
patches.route: also offered as a commit on ergoplatform/ergo#2424 (a-shannon), which covers the far-from-tip branch

patches.title: Check a header's age against its parent's own height, not the height index
patches.fixes: a valid header validated while its parent's indexes are unwritten (HistoryStorage.insert writes objects first) is rejected as invalid, its sender penalized, and it is not requested again (seen at 2 CPUs: a follower stuck at height 2)
patches.witness: unit HeaderParentWriteGapSpecification fails on v6.0.7 (MalformedModifierError hdrTooOld ... None), passes with the fix; history specs 56/56; network: 1 of 12 runs at 2 CPUs on the release
responses: 2026-09-26: third commit (guard test for the age check) pushed

patches.title: Do not request announced ADProofs on a node that stores the UTXO set
patches.fixes: a UTXO node downloads, through announcements, the ADProofs it regenerates itself (93% of ADProofs + transaction bytes on mainnet over 30 blocks)
patches.witness: unit ErgoNodeViewSynchronizerSpecification 'a node that stores the UTXO set does not request announced ADProofs' fails on v6.0.7, passes with the fix; whole spec 32/32; relay witness 4/4

patches.title: Drop a requested copy of a modifier already in history instead of penalizing the sender
patches.fixes: a reply for a modifier the node already applied is judged invalid and the answering peer penalized (seen on weak-blocks: 5 of 12 Matrix devnet runs)
patches.witness: unit ErgoNodeViewSynchronizerSpecification 'a requested header/extension that is already in history is not judged invalid' fail on v6.0.7 (peer penalized), pass with the fix; whole spec 33/33; composes with #2571 (merged, 4/4)

patches.title: Log a cached copy of a stored modifier as a duplicate, not as permanently invalid
patches.fixes: the modifiers cache logs a second copy of a stored modifier as permanently invalid (WARN + stack trace); removal unchanged
patches.witness: unit ErgoModifiersCacheSpec (stored header + stored proofs copies) fails on v6.0.7 with both warnings, passes with the fix; with VerifyADHistorySpecification 21/21 x3

patches.title: Serve a newly mined block's header and sections from memory until it is applied
patches.fixes: a mined block is announced before it is applied; peers' first requests go unanswered and wait the 10 s delivery timeout
